sources.finding: Layering and persistence conventions; features are computed then stored, models consume stored inputs.
Lookahead, held-out tickers, no live model writes, PR and full Bazel test requirements.
Gazelle is known broken; copy existing manual BUILD patterns.
Persisted pipeline inputs automatically become ordinary candidate model inputs; there is no separate new-feature activation gate.
build_features explicitly concatenates category builders; a new module can exist without being called or persisted.
RESEARCH_CANDIDATE_COLUMNS is historical experiment metadata, not an opt-in restriction.
ExperimentalFeatureView is distinct from production FeatureView.
experimental_views() is explicitly separate from FeatureService; currently empty because all SVM outputs were promoted.
experimental_features() exposes description/computation/example metadata without adding pipeline columns.
Existing immutable ExperimentalFeature dataclass has name, description, computation, example fields.
build_training_frame shifts all ordinary inputs once and restores only explicitly open-known columns.
build_inference_row copies prior snapshot and recomputes known current-opening values only; current serving need not call experimental dip calculations.
Existing isolated train/evaluate loop accepts included_features; never saves model/pruning/configuration state.

recommended_isolation.module: Add a pure features/dip_context.py module that returns explicitly morning-decision-aligned values and documents every dependency date.
recommended_isolation.research_adapter: An explicit experimental adapter joins those rows by ticker/date after the existing build_training_frame has aligned the baseline and label. Do not pass already shifted candidates through that builder again.
recommended_isolation.live_parity: Provide a helper taking completed prior history plus an observed current opening price and reuse the same calculations. Test equivalence to the historical row while leaving production inference callers unchanged.
recommended_isolation.metadata: Reuse experimental metadata catalog/registry paths if discovery in the feature UI is desired. Keep candidates out of production FeatureService and catalog.list_feature_columns(). Alternatively keep metadata local to the research module until promotion; this is an orchestrator choice.
recommended_isolation.production_activation: Do not add the module to pipeline.build_features or modify production snapshots/selection/prunes. Current model input lists and default nightly training stay unchanged. Later promotion must deliberately settle pipeline format and live recomputation.
recommended_isolation.alternative: A raw mixed close-known/open-known builder plus optional dataset/inference arguments is possible, but changes core signatures and raises double-shift and default-activation risk. Do not take that path without explicit review.

proposed_feature_contract.status: Proposed for phase-1 signoff; not implemented.
signatures: morning_dip_row(prior_history: pd.DataFrame, today_open: float, as_of_date: date) -> pd.Series
proposed_feature_contract.alignment: The output index is the prediction/entry date. All historical dependencies stop at t-1. Current opening price may enter open-conditioned columns. Research must join these outputs after baseline build_training_frame; never shift this output again.
proposed_feature_contract.input_contract: Require unique ascending session dates and explicit OHLCV columns. The caller supplies the complete relevant session calendar, representing unavailable bars as NaN rather than silently dropping sessions. The experimental SPY-aligned cache already follows that shape. Do not sanitize away an Open-only current placeholder row.
proposed_feature_contract.row_helper: Reject prior-history dates at or after as_of_date. Append one current-date row with only Open populated, then call the same vector builder and select that row. This proves shared calculation semantics without connecting production inference.
proposed_feature_contract.validity: Use floating 0/1/NaN flags; NaN means required inputs are unknown. Validity fields explicitly report availability. A252-session low requires252 preceding complete valid bars. Missing history must not become a false signal or an artificially shorter window.
strict_timing_details: Most recent tied prior low determines age; yesterday's low has age1.
Pre-shock volatility uses20 daily returns ending t-3, excluding both selloff days.
Reclaim support is min(L[t-21:t-1]), exactly20 completed lows before yesterday.
Current/future HLCV changes may alter later feature rows but never the current decision row.
Volume z-score in current-gap interaction ends t-1; existing candle gap_volume_interaction is a different shifted input.
All prices must have one documented compatible adjustment basis; the module does not repair corporate actions or provider histories.
proposed_feature_contract.metadata_scope: Orchestrator approved experimental_views/catalog.experimental_features integration; keep ordinary pipeline catalog and production FeatureService unchanged. Descriptions, formulas and examples must cover every new candidate.
